description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain activation lifecycle, specifically testing deactivation on idle behavior and stress scenarios. It defines a test class with multiple test methods, setup and teardown logic, and auxiliary configuration classes.

classes.name: DeactivateOnIdleTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for grain deactivation on idle and stress scenarios, setup and cleanup logic, and auxiliary configuration classes.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures client builder options, specifically limiting gateways.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo host options, specifically setting MaxForwardCount.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test cluster with optional custom builder.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the test cluster by stopping silos and disposing resources.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTestInside_Basic
methods.description: Tests that a grain deactivates and reactivates upon idle timeout.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_1
methods.description: Stress test deactivating a grain and repeatedly calling GetAge.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_2_NonReentrant
methods.description: Stress test concurrent deactivation and multiple increments to a counter.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_3_Reentrant
methods.description: Stress test concurrent increments and deactivation with reentrant grain.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_4_Timer
methods.description: Stress test starting multiple timers and then deactivating the grain.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_5
methods.description: Stress test concurrent counter increments and deactivation.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_11
methods.description: Bulk concurrent counter increments as stress test.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle_NonExistentActivation_1
methods.description: Test deactivation behavior on a non-existent activation with forwardCount=0.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle_NonExistentActivation_2
methods.description: Test deactivation behavior on a non-existent activation with forwardCount=1.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle_NonExistentActivation_Runner
methods.description: Runs the non-existent activation test with specified forwardCount.

methods.name: PickGrainInNonPrimary
methods.description: Selects a grain activated on a non-primary silo for testing.
